subject: Mapping estimated RR values of disease incidence and associated predictor variables

messages.author: a259015b36a46546
messages.subject: Mapping estimated RR values of disease incidence and associated predictor variables
parts:
Hello, INLA-users.

I came across this paper "Spatial-temporal mapping of hand foot and mouth disease and the long-term effects associated with climate and socio-economic variables in Sichuan Province, China from 2009 to 2013". In figure 4 the authors mapped the effect of the covariates on Hand Foot and Mouth Disease. I was wondering if anyone knows how this can be done? I want to replicate something similar for a study I am doing on dementia.

I have attached the paper and the figure in this post.

NB: I reached out to the authors but haven't received any response. 

Regards,

new book by Virgilio, see www.r-inla.org/books
